claim: WorkSwarm artifact preview pages are reused across Worker context assemblies through a coordinator-owned FIFO cache keyed by CAS hash and preview limit. Concurrent misses for the same key share a bounded per-key async lock, so one caller performs the verified disk read while other contexts reuse its result. The page cache is bounded to 32 MiB and 4096 entries; each hit validates the Artifact declared size.
